extracted.intended_audience: artists and scholars applying for residential fellowships (arts and humanities)
extracted.subtask_description: Applying for a one-month residential Bogliasco Center Fellowship in Italy for artists and scholars developing significant new work in the arts and humanities. The program accepts applicants across career stages and nationalities and runs multiple cohorts each year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship purpose / project focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards one-month residential Fellowships to individuals of all ages and nationalities who are developing significant new work in the arts and humanities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellows are expected to be engaged in developing substantial new creative or scholarly work in arts and humanities disciplines; the residency is intended to support that development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — age and nationality
rubrics_metrics.description: Individuals of all ages and nationalities (the program is open internationally).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is no age or nationality restriction; applicants may come from any country.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible fields / disciplines
rubrics_metrics.description: Arts and humanities (the program supports work across disciplines; 2026 awardees represent 11 disciplines).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Center encourages interdisciplinary exchange across all disciplines within arts and humanities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Residency duration and format
rubrics_metrics.description: One-month residential fellowships; month-long residencies between January and May divided into 4 distinct cohorts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellows live and work on-site in the Villa dei Pini near Genoa in an intimate group setting designed to encourage inquiry and exchange.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career-stage inclusivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports exceptional early-, mid-, and late-career artists and scholars.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection includes a mix of career stages; applicants from any career stage may apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special Fellowships
rubrics_metrics.description: The Center designates Special Fellowships for particular semesters (example: Fall 2025 and Spring 2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There are named/special fellowships in addition to the standard cohort awards; details and eligibility for those are program-specific.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program scale and diversity goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Award cohort size and international representation (example: Spring 2026 - 36 awardees representing 11 disciplines and 16 countries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Center appears to aim for disciplinary and international diversity within each cycle of fellows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application timing / portal availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Application portal availability is time-limited; the portal is closed currently and will reopen in the fall.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must apply during the open application period; the site links to more details on application process and requirements when available.
